title: AmEx Explorer: 75,000 Points with $4,000 Spend in 90 Days, 50,000 Pts with $4,000 Spend in 90 Days of 2nd Year, $395 Annual Fee
body:
Deal: AmEx Explorer: 75,000 Points with $4,000 Spend in 90 Days, 50,000 Pts with $4,000 Spend in 90 Days of 2nd Year, $395 Annual Fee

[Mild October] Card Members who currently hold or who have previously held any Card product issued by American Express Australia Limited in the past 18 months are ineligible for this offer.
I'm still waiting…
However if I get this card and convert to Cathay Asia Miles, the ratio now seems to be 3:1… Shame.
[Mr-NPC] So does that mean you have to stop your card and wait 18 months -_-
How about just being on someone else card as a second card holder? Does that count?
[Mild October] I think it starts the cool down after you officially terminated the card.
Not sure about being a second card holder will affected by this.
Personally I don't think so as you are not the primary holder and the account is not under your name.
Anyone had this kind of situation?
[WoodYouLikeSomeCash] Being an AU doesn’t count so you can apply and be eligible.
[blitzn] What is the 75000 points worth compared to the annual fee?
[Mild October] IMHO the $400 travel credit already compensated for the annual fee as long as you use it. So AMEX reward points seems a extra bonus to me.
[Karforoffer] What about them declining applications without checking any documentation? Even though it's been over 24 months since I closed my last amex.
[WoodYouLikeSomeCash] What income are you using? You need to be above the 55K mark or it will auto reject.
[fivespice] I should not have any trouble getting an Amex (or any credit card for that matter) yet I haven't been approved for an Amex in five years…
[The big weasel] Any good deals on the ultimate or is this the go to right now?
[Jasongood] After wandering in Amex website for a while I got a targetted offer of:
100,000 Points with $4,000 Spend in 90 Days, plus
50,000 Pts with $4,000 Spend in 90 Days of 2nd year
Total 150,000 Pts
